The WOC did not have the ability to record any of the lines on September 11, 
2001. Following 9/11 that capability was added. However, there are some secure 
communication lines that are not recorded.

The WOC "Guidelist" that was followed and completed on September 11, 2001, is 
no longer available. The Guidelist is used, in the event such as an aerial hijack, to 
provide a list of those to be contacted and a form with blanks to indicate the time 
that each person was contacted.
